    "R1 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/change_domain.rs:449-475 and apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/native_confirmation.rs:187-255: RevealSecret clones the held secret and leaves the core receipt Held. Closing, copying or timing out the sheet drops only the host copy; the core can reveal the original again indefinitely in the same context. This contradicts DESIGN.md's expiry on dialog close or 60 seconds after first reveal and the sheet's own claim that it cannot be shown again. The retained native procedure actually reveals the same receipt again after Copy and Close. Give the receipt and native presentation one scoped lifecycle that revokes all retained copies on close/expiry/retirement, with timers bound to the particular reveal. Acceptance: after Close, Copy and Close, or first-reveal expiry, that receipt refuses another reveal and no core-held plaintext remains; another key's reveal is unaffected by an older timer. Clipboard cleanup keeps its separate copy-time deadline and foreign-owner protection.",
    "R2 (medium) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/change_domain.rs:327-329,365-418: review age is checked only when RequestApply opens the sheet. settle_confirmation checks nonce and context but never expiry, so a sheet opened within the 15-minute lifetime can remain open past expiry and then authorize a write. Revalidate expiry before accepting/consuming the confirmation and expose the expired state without dispatch. Acceptance: open a valid confirmation, advance beyond REVIEW_LIFETIME without changing context or baseline, then accept; no mutation is admitted or sent, and a new review can proceed.",
    "R3 (medium) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/change_domain.rs:391-418: confirmation acceptance removes the review and marks it consumed before binding acquisition and Operations::admit succeed. The operation registry explicitly returns Busy on a full queue (runtime.rs:192-197); this branch silently returns with neither a review nor a change result. Make review consumption and successful operation admission atomic, and expose admission failure to the operator. Acceptance: hold the confirmation, fill the operation queue, then accept; nothing is written, the capacity failure is visible, and the review is not silently consumed without an operation. A subsequent explicit retry requires fresh confirmation and can dispatch at most once."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "E1 — docs/planning/chunks/C09.md requires per-operation independent request fixtures and readback. The executed runtime_changes cases and native C09 procedure do not exercise security-profile create/update/delete, application update, or API-key version/delete through the production authority-to-SDK path. Router branches and schema/unit tests are insufficient evidence for those six supported paths. Add independently authored exact method/path/query/body/header expectations and operation-specific readback assertions for every supported kind/action, then retain successful results against the new frozen inputs. Include the required transport-level negative assertion for preview-only PI/directional options; the current frontend check stops at a scripted renderer intent.",
    "E2 — DESIGN.md's modal editor/context lease and C09's native retirement acceptance are not fully demonstrated. review-apply.test.tsx:142-157 checks readOnly and refused typing; runtime_changes tests edits before RequestApply and tenant retirement through a scripted confirmer. No supplied case captures a programmatic draft change while confirmation is pending and then resolves that confirmation, and the ten native C09 checks do not retire an open confirmation or secret sheet. Supply production-interface evidence that such a captured change invalidates the pending hold, plus actual native evidence that retirement ends both kinds of sheet and late completion cannot write or reveal."
  ],
